SAMAIRA BRIDAL

Blush rose bridal lehenga, Colombian emeralds & antique uncut polki suite — heritage haveli campaign and 4K cinema suite.

CLIENT Samaira Heritage Fine Jewellery
DISCIPLINE Haute Jewellery & Bridal Couture · 4K Cinema & Stills
PACKAGE Heritage Bridal Campaign Suite (Full Production)
YEAR 2026

Imperial Polki, Emerald Radiance & Heritage Poise.

Set against the golden sandstone arches and sun-drenched colonnades of a historic palace haveli, this campaign balances the regal weight of handcrafted uncut polki diamonds, carved Colombian emerald drops, and Basra pearls with a modern, airy blush rose bridal silhouette.

Engineered as an integrated luxury campaign suite by Kriyon Media, the production brings together a 4K vertical cinema master crafted for editorial social flagships, paired with ultra-high-resolution architectural, lookbook portraits, and dedicated macro jewellery product plates built for luxury flagships, digital showcases, and billboard campaigns.
